hooks.command: $stdin = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $json = $stdin | ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd = $json.tool_input.command; if ($null -eq $cmd) { exit 0 }; $deletePattern = '(^|[\s;&|])(rm|del|erase|Remove-Item|ri)\b'; $targetPattern = 'expense_tracker\.db'; $broadPattern = '(^|[\s;&|])(rm|Remove-Item|ri)\s+.*(-rf|-Recurse|-r\b|\*|"\."|\s\.\s*$|\s\.\s)'; if ($cmd -match $deletePattern -and ($cmd -match $targetPattern -or $cmd -match $broadPattern)) { $out = @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = 'PreToolUse'; permissionDecision = 'deny'; permissionDecisionReason = 'BLOCKED: this command could delete expense_tracker.db, the app database. Delete it manually outside of a tool call if this is intentional.' } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 5; Write-Output $out }; exit 0

python3 -c "
import sys, json, subprocess
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
file = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
if file.endswith('.py'):
    subprocess.run(['venv/Scripts/python.exe', '-m', 'black', '--quiet', file])
"
